name: Willis
main_effect:
[On Play] You may hatch 1 Digi-Egg card to an empty space in your breeding area.
[Your Turn] When one of your Digimon would digivolve into a Digimon card with [Gargomon] or [Rapidmon] in their name, you may suspend this Tamer to reduce the digivolution cost by 1.
source_effect: Security Effect [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
